picks.title: Loopmasters’ sampling powerhouse Loopcloud just got a massive update – here’s what’s new
picks.rationale: New release: Loopcloud 8 adds intelligent idea-generation tools, new effects, FLIP presets and an iOS sketch app, so producers can use it in their sessions right away.
picks.excerpt: Loopcloud 8 brings new intelligent tools for idea generation, new effects, fresh presets for FLIP, and a brand-new iOS app for laying down ideas on the go.

picks.title: Suno admits it has not deleted all the recordings used to train its AI, in answer to UMG and Sony's 'laundering' lawsuit
picks.rationale: New court filing: in a 44-page answer filed October 20 in Massachusetts federal court, Suno admits it still holds some of the recordings it trained on. This is a concrete development in the UMG/Sony v Suno case.
picks.excerpt: In a 44-page answer filed October 20 in the US District Court for Massachusetts, Suno admits it has not deleted all of the recordings it used to train its AI models, responding to UMG and Sony's 'laundering' claims.

picks.title: YouTube report provides insight into latest AI UGC trend
picks.rationale: New report: YouTube's Culture & Trends survey of about 700 US creators finds 72% already use AI on their videos and 61% want to insert themselves into content. That is fresh data on demand for AI UGC that music marketers can plan around.
picks.excerpt: YouTube has published a new Culture & Trends report, looking at how people use generative AI to express themselves creatively – and it points to some interesting new UGC potential. picks.title: MixJudge: Learning a Language-Queryable Critic for Vocal Mixing
picks.rationale: New research: MixJudge trains an audio-language critic on a curriculum of 11 vocal-mix issues at graded severity, so it can judge what is wrong with a vocal mix, not only give general mixing advice.
picks.excerpt: Mixing requires not only applying processing but also assessing the resulting mix. picks.title: Piano2Pop: Expanding Piano Demos into Pop Productions Without Aligned Supervision
picks.rationale: New research: Piano2Pop conditions a pretrained flow-matching music model on piano MIDI to expand a bare piano demo into a full instrumental pop arrangement, an AI path from sketch to production that songwriters can follow.
picks.excerpt: We introduce Piano2Pop, a music-expansion task that transforms piano MIDI into instrumental pop productions. Enabled by recent advances in music generation and polyphonic music transcription, our pseudo-supervised approach conditions a pretrained flow-matching model on piano rolls without aligned piano-pop supervision.
